name: fjord-ledger

subject.name: Fjord Ledger
subject.audience: Bookkeepers at small Nordic shipping firms, working early mornings and late evenings in harbor offices
subject.primaryJob: Reconcile a month of entries at a time without ever doubting a number
sources: Tide tables: dense columns of times and heights read at a glance
Ledger ruling: hairline rules that separate rows without decorating them
The working harbor outside the office window: painted steel hulls, cold flat light off water

principles: The grid organizes everything: columns line up across the whole month
Objective type: a neo-grotesque, flush left, numbers in tabular figures
No ornament: content before decoration, no maritime motifs
Restraint in color: neutrals carry the page, one accent marks action

territories.name: Working harbor
territories.description: The quay the bookkeepers look out on: painted steel hulls, wet stone, mooring lines, cold flat daylight off the water at dawn and dusk.
territories.light: flat, cold daylight off water; low light at both ends of the day
territories.composition: ruled columns and rows, like a tide table or a ledger page
territories.imagery: none in the interface; numbers are the content

muse.name: A printed Nordic tide table
muse.take: A whole month of numbers on one page, ruled and aligned so any value is found and trusted at a glance
muse.leave: Its nautical-chart decoration, cramped print sizes and almanac ornament

samples.error: Entry 214 is off by 1 250,00 NOK. Check the invoice date.

signature.concept: A whole month on one screen
signature.reason: Like the tide table muse, a month of entries must fit without scrolling: compact density, dense but calm.

avoid: Maritime decoration: anchors, ship wheels, rope, waves, nautical flags
Grids shown for their own sake

rationale.form.density: The signature: a full month of entries on one screen.
rationale.form.space: Departs from Swiss airy white space: the subject asks for a month without scrolling, so gutters stay tight and the grid does the calming.
rationale.form.line: Ledger ruling: hairline rules separate rows and columns.
rationale.form.elevation: Swiss flat surfaces over the harbor's layered canon: no surface should compete with the numbers.
rationale.color.character.vibrancy: Calm for long early and late sessions; muted keeps the signal red unmistakable.
rationale.color.character.neutral: Between Swiss true grey and the harbor's tint: a trace of cold water in the greys.
rationale.color.character.emphasis: Selection shows quietly so a dense table stays calm.
rationale.type.character.type-scale: Departs from Swiss dramatic: headings step gently so they do not eat rows of the month.
rationale.movement: Swiss stillness: numbers never move under the eye.
rationale.adaptivity: Bookkeepers work at dawn and late evening, so light and dark carry equal weight.
rationale.iconography.set: Phosphor light matches the hairline line character.
rationale.grounding.primary: Inherited straight, as the team asks; only space and type scale yield to density.
